newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ballarat rejects revised GPG bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ballarat rejects revised GPG bid.

text.p: Ballarat Brewing Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its independent directors had recommended that shareholders reject the revised A$2.50 a share takeover bid by Guinness Peat Group Plc.

"Your independent directors, excluding Carlton and United Breweries (CUB) representatives, have met and recommend unanimously that you reject GPG's revised offer," Ballarat said in a letter to shareholders.
CUB is a unit of Foster's Brewing Group Ltd.

Ballarat said GPG's offer, which was lifted from A$2.45 a share last week, was below the fair value range for the company of between A$2.56 and A$2.93 given by independant valuers Grant Samuel and Associates.
GPG's revised bid, which closes February 6, also included Ballarat Brewing's four cent interim dividend, effectively raising the total consideration to A$2.54 a share.
Carlton and United also has made a A$2.50 cash per share bid for Ballarat.
Foster's is already the largest shareholder in Ballarat with a 42.4 percent stake. GPG holds 17.9 percent of Ballarat.
"Discussions are continuing with both CUB and GPG," Ballarat said.
Shares in Ballarat Brewing closed one cent lower at A$2.59.
